description: This Java source file defines the EntityDataLoadContainer class, which manages data loading operations such as seed and initial data loads in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initialization, configuration, tenant handling, and executing data load procedures, including constraint management and URL preparation for data files.

classes.name: EntityDataLoadContainer
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing data load operations in OFBiz, including initialization, tenant handling, constraint management, and data file URL preparation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container, disables certain services, and triggers data loading for specified tenants or delegators.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container, returns true.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container (no implementation).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container's name.

methods.name: getTenantList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tenants if multitenancy is enabled.

methods.name: loadDataForDelegator
methods.description: Performs data loading operations for a specific delegator, including constraint management and data file processing.

methods.name: isPropertySet
methods.description: Checks if a property key is set to 'true' or null.

methods.name: getEntityGroupNameFromConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the entity group name from configuration or overrides it.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Obtains a delegator instance based on configuration or override.

methods.name: getDelegatorFromProp
methods.description: Creates a delegator from a property value.

methods.name: getBaseDelegator
methods.description: Returns the base delegator if the current delegator is tenant-specific.

methods.name: getHelperInfo
methods.description: Retrieves database helper info for a delegator and entity group.

methods.name: getModelEntities
methods.description: Gets the model entity map for a delegator and entity group.

methods.name: createOrUpdateComponentEntities
methods.description: Creates or updates component entries in the database.

methods.name: dropDbConstraints
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints, indices, and related database constraints.

methods.name: createDbConstraints
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints and indices in the database.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Drops primary keys from database tables.

methods.name: createPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Creates primary keys for database tables.

methods.name: repairDbColumns
methods.description: Repairs database column sizes and structures.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data from URLs into the database, managing transactions and error handling.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Parses transaction timeout value from string.

methods.name: prepareDataUrls
methods.description: Prepares list of data file URLs from files, directories, and readers.

methods.name: getLoadFiles
methods.description: Splits comma-separated file list into individual file paths.

methods.name: isDataReadersEnabled
methods.description: Determines if data readers should be enabled based on inputs.

methods.name: prepareTenantLoadComponents
methods.description: Prepares list of components to load for a tenant.

methods.name: retireveDataUrlsFromFileList
methods.description: Converts file paths to URLs, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveDataUrlsFromDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves URLs of XML files from a directory.

methods.name: logDataLoadingPlan
methods.description: Logs the plan for data loading files.

methods.name: createDataLoadMessage
methods.description: Formats a message indicating rows loaded from a data file.

methods.name: logDataLoadingResults
methods.description: Logs summary of data load results and errors.
